meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review feedback before implementing changes

howto.what: 收到代码审查反馈后，Claude 会先完整阅读，再用自己的话重述需求或提问，然后对照代码库验证技术正确性，最后做出技术性确认或推理反驳，并逐一实施并测试。
howto.when: 当收到代码审查反馈时触发，尤其是反馈不清楚或技术上可疑时。

say.text: 审查者建议删除遗留代码，请验证兼容性后再回复。
say.note: Claude 将检查代码库实际需求。

say.text: 我不确定第4点和第5点，请先澄清再实施。
say.note: Claude 将暂停并询问细节。

howto.what_en: Upon receiving code review feedback, Claude will first read it fully, then restate the requirement or ask questions, verify technical correctness against the codebase, and respond with technical acknowledgment or reasoned pushback, implementing and testing each item one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when receiving code review feedback, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: The reviewer suggests removing legacy code. Please verify compatibility first.
say_en.note: Claude will check actual usage in codebase.

say_en.text: I'm unclear on items 4 and 5. Please clarify before proceeding.
say_en.note: Claude will stop and ask for details.
